class.name: IfcEvaporativeCoolerType
class.brief_description: The energy conversion device type IfcEvaporativeCoolerType defines commonly shared information for occurrences of evaporative coolers. The set of shared information may include: common properties with shared property sets common representations of shape common materials common composition of elements common ports applicable assignment of process types It is used to define a evaporative cooler spec

members.member: Defines the type of evaporative cooler.
